notes:
gm Quick preview of the website. What are NORMIES? I came up with an idea of creating unique pixel art. They are not pixel perfect or trait based generation. Basically algorithm creates AI images, and turn them into pixel art in a 40x40 canvas. Outputs are SVG (file size 5-20 bytes), which i plan to make this collection fully on-chain on ethereum mainnet. NORMIES have attributes, traits but each trait is in different shape, so all NORMIES are 1/1. Supply, mint date, mint price TBA In few days i will share the website, so you can play with it, create your NORMIES until minting.

Designer: @serc1n. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
